name: Kateřína N.
text: We specced six team rigs with the Builder in twenty minutes. Compatibility warnings caught a cooler clash our old vendor shipped.

name: Marcus B.
text: The price-history charts saved me €400 timing a 7950X purchase. Nothing else tracks street prices this cleanly.

name: Devansh P.
text: Comparison pages with percent deltas are exactly what I wanted for my first build. The glossary taught me enough to argue with shop staff.

name: Sofia R.
text: They actually index Pentium 4 and HD 7970 era parts. Historical section is a museum with charts.

name: Tomáš H.
text: Offline mode is the killer feature — I spec upgrades in basements with no signal. Works like a native app.

name: Yuki M.
text: Game benchmark DB helped me pick minimum-spec targets that don’t alienate 60% of my players.
